Class Inventory

java.lang.Object
common.Inventory
public class Inventory extends Object
Manages the vehicles at one rental location and keeps rental records. This class contains application logic; the console menu is handled elsewhere.

    • getIndexByID

      private int getIndexByID(String identifier)
      Finds the list position of a vehicle ID, ignoring surrounding spaces.
      Parameters:
      identifier - the vehicle ID to search for
      Returns:
      the vehicle's index, or -1 when the ID is invalid or absent

    • addVehicle

      public void addVehicle(Vehicle asset, String identifier)
      Adds a vehicle and records the addition in its history. Blank IDs, duplicate IDs, duplicate vehicle objects, and null vehicles are ignored so the inventory stays consistent.
      Parameters:
      asset - the vehicle to add
      identifier - the unique ID to assign to the vehicle

    • findVehicleByObject

      private boolean findVehicleByObject(Vehicle asset)
      Checks whether the exact vehicle object is already in the inventory. Reference equality is used because two distinct cars may have identical details.
      Parameters:
      asset - the vehicle object to check
      Returns:
      true if this object is already present

    • findVehicle

      public Vehicle findVehicle(String identifier)
      Finds a vehicle by its ID.
      Parameters:
      identifier - the ID to search for; surrounding spaces are ignored
      Returns:
      the matching vehicle, or null if no vehicle matches

    • getAvailableVehicles

      public ArrayList<Vehicle> getAvailableVehicles()
      Makes a new list containing vehicles that are not currently rented. Changes to the returned list do not change the inventory itself.
      Returns:
      a list of currently available vehicles

    • getActiveRentals

      public ArrayList<Rental> getActiveRentals()
      Makes a new list of rentals that have not yet been returned.
      Returns:
      a list of active rentals

    • isAvailable

      public boolean isAvailable(String identifier)
      Checks whether an inventory vehicle is not part of an active rental.
      Parameters:
      identifier - the vehicle ID to check
      Returns:
      true only when the ID belongs to an available vehicle

    • rentVehicle

      public Rental rentVehicle(Vehicle asset, Renter renter, int duration)
      Starts a rental when the vehicle is in this inventory and available. A successful rental is saved and written to the vehicle's history.
      Parameters:
      asset - the vehicle to rent
      renter - the customer renting it
      duration - the rental length in days; must be positive
      Returns:
      the new rental, or null if the request is invalid or unavailable

    • returnVehicle

      public Rental returnVehicle(String identifier)
      Completes the active rental for a vehicle and records its return.
      Parameters:
      identifier - the ID of the vehicle being returned
      Returns:
      the completed rental, or null if there is no active rental

    • removeVehicle

      public void removeVehicle(String identifier)
      Removes an available vehicle and records the removal in its history. Missing IDs and vehicles with active rentals are safely ignored.
      Parameters:
      identifier - the ID of the vehicle to remove

    • cntDays

      public int cntDays(Date checkout, Date checkin)
      Calculates the number of days between two dates using their day codes.
      Parameters:
      checkout - the rental start date
      checkin - the rental return date
      Returns:
      the day-code difference from checkout to checkin
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if either date is null
